column1: # Rows db.o4b2_10.* (line NP item O4b2-10): a batch whose prefetch meets a Seq-align id whose lookup throws (a text tag): NCBI's prefetch loads the Seq-id handles below the failing one in its map and ends there (BLASTDB=tests/seqdb/taxdb/offset_last_past_end; tests/db_search/ids/ptagc_t5, ptagx_t5 of make_ids.py --pfworder-only); NCBI wrote the same bytes of each ncbi row in four heap layouts. The losat-rejection rows: the default outfmt 6 (NCBI's null pointer exception reports its own addresses).
